samples.question: The gold START tile shows the lamp (dark means ON; light means OFF); the gate begins READY. Read the six event tiles in row order. A cyan PULSE flips the lamp only when the gate is READY, then makes the gate EXHAUSTED. A coral RECHARGE advances EXHAUSTED to WARMING, or WARMING to READY; otherwise it leaves the gate READY. Pulses while the gate is not READY do nothing. Is the lamp ON after all six tiles?
